milestone_text: Holds head up when on tummy and moves both arms and legs
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Pays attention to faces and looks at a toy for several seconds
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Makes gurgling or cooing sounds and turns head toward sounds
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Calms down when spoken to or picked up and smiles when you talk to them
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Rolls from tummy to back and pushes up with straight arms when on tummy
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Brings things to mouth to explore them and reaches to grab a toy
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Makes sounds back when talked to and blows raspberries
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Knows familiar faces and likes to look at self in a mirror
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Pulls up to stand and walks holding on to furniture
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Puts things into a container and looks for objects they see you hide
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Waves bye-bye and calls at least one parent mama or dada
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Plays games with you like peek-a-boo and pat-a-cake
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Walks without holding on to anyone or anything and scribbles
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Plays pretend like feeding a doll and points to show interest
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Says several single words and tries to say three or more words besides mama or dada
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Moves away from you to explore but looks back to make sure you are near
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Kicks a ball and runs
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Holds something in one hand while using the other hand and operates switches or buttons
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Says at least two words together like More milk and points to things in a book when asked
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Notices when others are hurt or upset and looks at your face to see how to react
source_label: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.
